canonical_statement_de: Kontext, Autoritaet und Bedeutung gehoeren zusammen.
purpose: Preserve causal-epistemic resolution by preventing context, authority, meaning, evidence, state, causality, effect and proof from being silently collapsed.

decision_rule.priority: smallest causally sufficient, history-preserving action with the greatest verifiable progress toward the standing architecture
reject: productive action without exact binding, authority or evidence

non_claims: This policy does not confer independent review authority.
This policy does not imply PASS, FINAL_PASS or EFFECT_ACK_DONE.
This policy does not replace domain-specific evidence or expertise.
